def check_solution(tour):
    if len(tour) != 36:
        return False, "Length is not 36"
    if len(set(tour)) != 36:
        return False, "Not all cells are unique"
    
    # Check fixed assignments
    fixed = {
        0: 0,
        3: 17,
        6: 24,
        17: 30,
        19: 6,
        29: 25,
        32: 21,
        34: 23
    }
    for step, cell in fixed.items():
        if tour[step] != cell:
            return False, f"Fixed assignment failed at step {step}: expected {cell}, got {tour[step]}"
            
    # Check knight moves
    for i in range(35):
        curr = tour[i]
        nxt = tour[i+1]
        r1, c1 = divmod(curr, 6)
        r2, c2 = divmod(nxt, 6)
        dr = abs(r1 - r2)
        dc = abs(c1 - c2)
        if not ((dr == 1 and dc == 2) or (dr == 2 and dc == 1)):
            return False, f"Invalid move from {curr} to {nxt} at step {i}"
            
    return True, "Valid"
